subtitle: plain key–value store
warnText: Writing to an existing path replaces the whole value; the previous one is not kept. Deletion is final too: a secret cannot be restored. Need history? Use KV v2.
jumpPlaceholder: Jump to a path prefix…  e.g. payments/db
emptyText: There are no keys in {{path}} yet. The first write creates the path automatically.
forbiddenText: The token policy does not allow the list operation on this path. Ask an administrator to add a policy or switch the token.
pickKey: Pick a key in the list on the left to see its value
readForbiddenText: The token has no read capability on {{path}}.
notFoundText: Nothing exists at {{path}}: it may have been deleted already.
dangerText: The previous value is not kept on overwrite or on delete.
deleteText: This will permanently delete the secret. KV v1 has no versions or trash: the value disappears at once and for good, and applications reading this path will get 404.
name: Name
nameHintPrefix: the prefix is set by the current folder
nameSpace: The name must not contain spaces.
nameSlashes: The path must not start or end with "/" or contain "//".
nameExists: This key already exists: its value will be replaced.
owarnText: Saving will erase the current value of {{path}} with no way back: KV v1 has no versions.
rawNote: The value is stored as is, without parsing.
valueEmpty: The value is empty. Enter a JSON object or switch to "Text".
jsonBad: Invalid JSON. Check quotes, commas and brackets.
fixJsonText: Fix the JSON error and try again.
stageDone: Written · previous value destroyed, no rollback
